c: Vibe Footwear, a sneaker brand sold in 900 stores
s: Vibe Footwear's sales are flat. Its core customers are over 30, and younger shoppers see the brand as outdated. A new line of recycled-material sneakers could appeal to teens and young adults, but costs more to make.
The chief marketing officer (judge) wants you and your partner to recommend how to position and launch the new line.
f: Recycled line cost: $6 more per pair; retail price $95
p: Describe factors used by marketers to position products/services
Explain the concept of market and market identification
Explain the nature of marketing plans
Explain the nature of product/service branding
Explain factors affecting pricing decisions
n: Targets younger shoppers who value sustainability and style
Positions the line by values, design and price
Plans channels such as social, influencers and retail displays
Protects the existing brand while launching a new image
Prices to cover cost and compete
q: Would you use influencers to promote the line? Why or why not?
How would you avoid being accused of greenwashing?
